name: Xiangqi (Shawn) Wang
title: PhD Candidate
bio: I am a PhD candidate at the University of Notre Dame, working on LLM continual learning: enabling models to adapt from experience while preserving reliable reasoning and aligned behavior. My research spans test-time training, self-distillation, reinforcement learning, and adaptive agent systems, connecting principled algorithms with efficient deployment.

research.title: Continual adaptation
research.description: Meta-learned test-time adaptation and locality-constrained self-distillation for better reasoning with limited behavioral drift.

research.title: Reliable reasoning & alignment
research.description: Coherence-aware reinforcement learning and multi-objective preference alignment, balancing truthfulness, anti-sycophancy, empathy, and creativity.

research.title: Adaptive inference & online learning
research.description: Reinforcement learning controllers for adaptive reasoning and fairness-aware contextual bandits with sublinear-regret guarantees.

experience.description: AI Functions in SQL & LLM Systems
highlights: Developed SAGE, a unified algebra and adaptive execution framework for SQL AI functions, optimizing model selection and query execution for quality, cost, and latency.

education.degree: PhD Candidate, Computer Science and Engineering

education.institution: University of Science and Technology of China

mentorship: I guide student-led projects from problem selection and method design through experiments and writing, turning research ideas into reproducible results and publication-ready manuscripts.
